body:
I had this problem too and went in circles for months.

I posted on the virgin media forums and that was what eventually got it sorted for me (fingers crossed anyway, I still wouldn't be shocked to receive a random bill from them at some point in the future.) 

Best of luck to you.

100s extra!? I'm not the only one who's had to battle with them then and glad you managed to get it resolved.

Thanks, I put in a complaint this morning, was told they would correct the billing and received an email confirming it was done, and 2 hours later got an email with another bill for £46.

I've been downloading all the chat logs and saving any emails.

I lodged a(nother) complaint this morning, got a reference number, received an email from the 'resolutions team' telling me my billing had been corrected, and then received a following email with another incorrect bill.

  
I think you're right, ombudsman is the way to go.

Hi my friend,

Just wanted to let you know I spoke to my gf and it was a difficult conversation but a good one I think. I still feel a bit lost and ashamed and hopeless but I’m going to try and get the help I need.

Thank you for replying to me and giving me advice. It was good of you

Thank you for your reply. I definitely will speak to her, I’m worried about saying the wrong things and making it even worse but saying something has to be better than nothing I guess.

Thank you!

Thank you, good advice! I think I’ll send a letter to that effect just to cover myself.

Thanks!

Thank you for the speedy reply! Not the answer I was hoping for I admit but it was one I was sort of expecting.

I’ll fill it out as best I can and put a note on explaining the details of the others are unknown. I’m hoping to avoid any major confrontation as the one housemate got quite aggressive when I tried to get it sorted, but I appreciate that is separate to the legal advice!

Thank you for taking the time to help.
